children.name: copy / transferNote
children.text: You will be able to change this selection one feature at a time. The verified USB writer installs a complete APP1 firmware image, so a changed selection currently needs a newly composed image and a full update.

children.name: copy / transferLimit
children.text: Independent feature uploads and runtime hot swapping have not been verified. USB installation requires the matching writer, chip/profile checks, full flash readback, a separate status check and a real reboot.

children.name: Bridge qualification
children.text: USB BRIDGE B2 must already be installed and freshly identified. First installation from untouched stock over normal USB is unverified.
